retrievalProfile.description: A monochromatic golden-sepia composition featuring a sharply dressed male figure in the foreground and a vintage luxury vehicle with a secondary figure in the background.
triggerTerms: gold-toned street scene with vintage car
excludeWhen: modern minimalist tech aesthetics are requested
high-contrast black and white photography is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A cinematic, warm-toned urban scene dominated by a sepia color grade. The composition uses a shallow depth of field to emphasize a male subject in formal attire (suit, tie, fedora) in the right foreground, while a classic black car and a female figure are positioned in the mid-ground under a scalloped architectural awning.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground subject offset to the right creates asymmetrical balance with the car on the left
Monochromatic sepia palette unifies disparate elements of fashion, automotive, and architecture
The scalloped awning edge acts as a framing device for the top-aligned typography
Leading lines from the car's open door and body point toward the central depth of the image
coreInvariants: Presence of a vintage luxury sedan with wire-spoke wheels
Formal urban fashion including a fedora and pinstriped suit

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary male subject is large-scale, positioned in the right foreground, cropped at the waist. Secondary female subject is small-scale, standing by the car door in the left mid-ground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The primary subject's face and the bright white typography at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the large white text, moves down to the primary subject's face, follows his gaze/body line to the car, and then to the secondary figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The ground and the architectural columns provide textured negative space that supports the subjects without clutter.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep sepia and ochre tones (background and shadows)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white (typography and highlights on the car)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high value range within a single hue family, creating a 'vintage gold' effect.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses high-contrast serifs with flared terminals
Secondary text uses a stylized, lowercase blackletter-inspired script
Extreme horizontal tracking for the subtitle
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 't' in the subtitle has a crossbar that extends significantly to the left

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed over the dark awning area for maximum contrast
Floats in the dark space between the awning and the subject

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for the name paired with a widely-spaced, lowercase calligraphic script for the title.

candidateDirections.reason: Similar flared serifs and high-waisted character structure
Captures the stylized, lowercase calligraphic feel of the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a sepia-toned urban scene featuring a man in a pinstriped suit and fedora in the foreground, a black vintage 1950s sedan with an open door in the mid-ground, and a woman in a black dress standing by the car, all under a scalloped building awning.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply bold white serif display text at the top center, followed by a widely-spaced lowercase calligraphic subtitle directly underneath.

verificationChecks: Is the entire image monochromatic sepia/gold?
Is the typography pure white for high contrast?
Is the primary subject positioned on the right side?
Does the subtitle have extreme horizontal spacing?

adjustableVariables: Specific model of the vintage car
Tracking width of the subtitle text
Depth of field blur on the background
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individuals
Exact brand logos on the vehicle

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the foreground subject
avoid: Casual clothing like t-shirts or jeans

postGenerationChecks: Check that the sepia tone is consistent across the car, people, and building.
Ensure the white text is legible against the dark awning.
Verify the vintage car has wire wheels and chrome details.
Confirm the pinstripe pattern on the suit is visible but subtle.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Sepia Sophistication = (Monochromatic Gold Wash + Vintage Luxury Car + Formal Fashion) * (High-Contrast Serif Typography / Wide-Tracked Subtitles)
